name: Alouette Baby Brie Toasts With Pear And Chocolate Wine Sauce
instructions: Combine wine and sugar in saucepan and reduce over medium heat for 10 minutes
Remove from heat and stir in the chocolate chips
Brush both sides with olive oil and broil until golden on both sides
In small skillet , toss almonds until golden brown
Remove from heat and toss with allspice
Place baguette rounds on cookie sheet
Spread 1 / 2 teaspoon of chocolate wine sauce on each slice
Divide minced pear evenly among the slices
Lay a slice of brie on top of each "crouton
Heat in 350 degree oven for five minutes
